turns.style: A small alien spy undercover on Earth, filing a secret field report to his Commander about a strange human thing he has just discovered, in American English. Deadpan, dry, quietly sarcastic; he never laughs at his own jokes. Warm and smooth, middle register, never shrill, soft on the s. Brisk with no dead air, but he lets each punchline land.
turns.text: Relax. On my planet, you step off... you float. <long pause> Commander. Report number one. On this planet... everything falls. <short pause> Apples. Cups. Me. <short pause> They call it gravity. Every object pulls every other object. The bigger it is, the harder it pulls. And Earth is VERY big. <short pause> It even keeps their Moon on a leash. <short pause> They drop their phones every day... and act surprised every time. <long pause> Question, Commander: if everything falls... why doesn't the Moon fall on them?
